nodes.title: Mass growth allowance by maturity
nodes.text: Growth added to each item's basic mass by how it was obtained: EST 20 %, CALC 10 %, DATASHEET 5 %, CAD 5 %, WEIGHED 1 %. An item may override. The pack carries 0 %: its listing spread is not growth but a bounding case, reported separately at 546 / 551 / 590 g (ASM-A3-PACK-RANGE, ASM-A3-PACK-NOMINAL, D-64).
nodes.basis: Maturity-based allowance after AIAA S-120A (mass properties control); percentages are A3's choice for a student foam build, ESTIMATE

nodes.title: Total U-spacer stack behind the pack
nodes.text: Printed U-spacers POD-008 2/4/6/8/8 mm (0-28 mm) between the pack aft face and the aft stop. The aft travel from the nominal station is P:pod.pack_aft_travel_m (no spacer, D-59: 12 mm; D-62 aft stop 0.050 for the 135 mm pack); the forward travel is that minus this stack, further limited by the crush stack (ASM-A3-NOSE-STACK)
nodes.basis: params/CHANGE-LOG.md D-47 (spacer set 2/4/6/8/8), D-59 and D-62; replace by subsystems/pod/params.json spacer_set_m once D2 publishes it

nodes.title: Flight-pack mass bounds (D-180 cost re-check, 2026-11-14)
nodes.text: Lightest and heaviest weighed mass of the ONE flight pack the CG, gate and load cases run with: CNHL Racing Series 4S 6000 mAh 15.2 V 130C LiHV Shorty hard case, listed 415.5 g (chinahobbyline.com listing, search snippet 2026-11-14, tolerance not stated: +/- 10 g EST) + 4 g for E2's own 10 AWG pigtails: [409.5, 429.5] g. The heavy bound IS the SKU listing maximum, so it equals the pass line the pack must meet (CL-A3-PACK-ACCEPT >= 429.5 g). The Gens Ace Redline Shorty (410 +/- 10 + 4 g = [404, 424]) is the fallback and sits inside this range at the heavy end
nodes.basis: review/CLOSURE-ROUND-2026-11-14/A3.md cost re-check; E2.md cost re-check (CNHL 6000 120C hard case 479 g fails this line: worst 484 g against 439 g); weigh each pack on arrival (T-E2-WEIGH). Was [546, 590] for the Ovonic 120C EC5 (D-64)

nodes.title: Flight-pack listed mass incl. pigtails (D-180 cost re-check)
nodes.text: CNHL Racing Series 4S 6000 130C LiHV Shorty: listed 415.5 g + 4 g pigtails = 419.5 g (EST). The parts.csv line carries battery.mass_kg (0.414 until A1 applies 0.4195). The middle CG / gate case runs at 419.5 g
nodes.basis: A3.md cost re-check; E2.md cost re-check

nodes.title: Length from the pod nose to the most forward pack fore face
nodes.text: D-150 pod as drawn (D2 wave 2): pod nose -0.147 to the forward-stop aft face -0.1382 (8.8 mm: nose wall, nose block, 3 mm stop) + XPS F-250 crush block >= 31.0 mm (the D-150 floor, CL-C5-BLOCK-L-CUT-MIN; not C5's 27.5 mm energy length) + 1.5 mm PETG spreader = 41.3 mm; most forward pack fore face -0.1057, so the 135 mm pack centroid is >= -0.0382 (= CL-D2-PACK-X-FWD-MIN, C3's crash fail-safe condition)
nodes.basis: review/DESIGN-ROUND-2026-11-14 A1.md D-150, D2-W2.md (stop -0.1382, ASM-D2-STACK-BLOCK-A1 0.031), C5-W2.md section 4 (request 0.0346 -> 0.0413), C3-W2.md section 3; was 0.0346 on the D-62 bay (nose -0.140, stop -0.1312, block 24.3 mm)

nodes.title: Per-pack flight station rule (D-98 mid-band; was D-59)
nodes.text: Each weighed pack flies at the whole spacer step (P:pod.pack_spacer_step_m), counted forward from the no-spacer station (nominal + P:pod.pack_aft_travel_m), that minimises the worse range use of the basic and the predicted CG (centres the basic-to-predicted band in cg.x_range_m), never ahead of the crush stack (ASM-A3-NOSE-STACK). After T-A3-CG-BALANCE the measured CG replaces both and the step nearest cg.x_target_m is flown
nodes.basis: params/CHANGE-LOG.md D-98 (H8: A1's mid-band rule; D-59 put the basic CG on target and left the growth on the aft side), CR-A1-53

nodes.title: Mass roll-up against allocations and the gate
nodes.equation: basic = sum m_i ; predicted = sum m_i (1 + MGA_i) ; margin = gate - predicted ; margin(pack m) = gate - (predicted - m_pack,carried + m) ; overrun_s = basic_s - alloc_s ; accept = m_pack,carried + margin - overrun

nodes.title: CG cases, pack station for the target, hover trim split
nodes.equation: cg = sum m_i r_i / sum m_i ; x_pack_req = (x_t M - (M x_cg - m_p x_p)) / m_p ; split = (z_m + z_cg) / (z_m - z_cg) ; h_stance = c - x_cg + foot ; fwd_room = (x_pack - L_pack/2) - x_pod_le - nose_stack ; range_use = |x - mid| / half-range ; shift_req(group) = (x_t - x_cg) M / m_group ; trim(pack m) = slide that brings x_cg(m) into range

nodes.title: Inertia tensor about the CG (aircraft frame)
nodes.equation: I = sum m_i (|r_i|^2 E - r_i r_i^T) + box self-inertia m/12 (b^2 + c^2) ; r_i from the CG

nodes.title: Group masses, centroids and own inertias for the loads model (CR-C1-33)
nodes.equation: per group g (and per station within g): m_g = sum m_i ; r_g = sum m_i r_i / m_g ; I_g = sum m_i (|r_i - r_g|^2 E - (r_i - r_g)(r_i - r_g)^T) + boxes ; closure: sum_g [I_g + m_g (|d_g|^2 E - d_g d_g^T)] = I_aircraft, d_g = r_g - r_cg
